env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Row O-A03: the -O level effects reach Go packages, under logos and plain go.
# The -O=3 budgets below come from the flagsFor registry; -O=2 is the
# second tier so both non-default tiers are pinned on a Go package.
cd gomod
logos build -a -x -O=3 .
stderr '-d=inlbudget=400,inlrecursivebudget=80,variablemakethreshold=4096'
go build -a -x -O=3 .
stderr '-d=inlbudget=400,inlrecursivebudget=80,variablemakethreshold=4096'
logos build -a -x -O=2 .
stderr '-d=inlbudget=120,variablemakethreshold=256'
go build -a -x -O=2 .
stderr '-d=inlbudget=120,variablemakethreshold=256'
cd ..

-- gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/w5optgo

go 1.27

-- gomod/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
